sentences.text: Fossils of this creature were discovered in the Late Jurassic Shishugou Formation located in Xinjiang, China.
Researchers estimate its wingspan reached a minimum of 1.73 meters.
It features a parietal crest, marking the first time such a structure has been identified in a non-pterodactyloid pterosaur.
Its teeth were sharply pointed and curved backward, with ridges on each side designed for slicing.
The genus was formally named and described in 2010 by Brian Andres, James Matthew Clark, and Xu Xing.
Compared to its relative Angustinaripterus, Sericipterus possessed a more robust constitution.
It shares distinctive narrow nostrils, a downward projection from the back of the cheek, and an inward curvature of posterior teeth with Angustinaripterus.
Taxonomists classify Sericipterus as the sister taxon of Angustinaripterus within the subfamily Rhamphorhynchinae.
This animal lived during the Oxfordian stage, between 161.5 and 154.8 million years ago.
